_comment: FIX130 — the one table for 'did the user explicitly ask to remember?'. chat-edge's ExplicitRememberRequest (explicit_remember.go) and the desktop host's explicitRememberRequest (apps/desktop/src/main/explicit-remember.ts) are both tested against these rows, so the two clients cannot drift. A save the model labels user_requested becomes an ACTIVE memory only when the turn's own user message matches; otherwise it is a pending suggestion the user confirms.
